title: FontVibe Copy-and-Paste Symbols: a symbol site's library with six-language category names and Unicode 16.0 facts
description:
The copy-and-paste symbol library behind fontvibe.ai — hearts, heart combos, stars, arrows, brackets, math, currency and other categories — as data. Order within each category is the order the site shows them; multi-character combos and emoji sequences are kept byte-exact, variation selectors included.

Every category is named in English, Spanish, Portuguese, German, Japanese and Chinese. Every code point carries its Unicode 16.0.0 name, general category, block, age and Emoji / Emoji_Presentation properties, and every entry its status and CLDR name in emoji-test.txt (Emoji 16.0) where listed. Nothing is typed in by hand: scripts/verify.py re-derives all of it from the official Unicode files and checks every number stated in the README.

Kaomoji are published separately. Also distributed as copy-paste-symbols on npm and PyPI. A browsable version is at fontvibe.ai/tools/heart-symbol.
